diagnostic_paths.title: High-Pressure Inline Bypass & Air Purge (Shopfloor Shortcut)
diagnostic_paths.description: 2-minute rapid pneumatic manifold bypass discovered by shopfloor operators.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Depress manual override pin on Solenoid 3-A using a 2mm Allen key.
2. Tap pneumatic regulator valve to dislodge condensation.
3. Cycle E-stop in rapid succession twice.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not leave bypass pin engaged during machine cutting cycle.

diagnostic_paths.title: Manual High-Pressure Solenoid Bypass (Fast Triage)
diagnostic_paths.description: 2-minute quick pin depress on rear manifold valve.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Depress manual solenoid 3-A override pin.
2. Tap valve housing.
3. Cycle E-stop.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not leave override tool inserted during auto cycle.

diagnostic_paths.title: Rapid Manual Bypass for Haas_Alarm_102
diagnostic_paths.description: Fast 2.0-min resolution detected by Shadow Observer.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps: 1. Rapid bypass / reset sequence performed by OP-001.
